properties.displayName: AI: deny model deployment types that can process data outside the allowed geography
properties.description: Data-residency guardrail. Blocks Foundry / Azure OpenAI model deployments whose deployment type (SKU) is not on the allowed list. Example use: a Canadian bank that only allows Standard (regional) or DataZone deployments. VERIFY the alias before use: run `az provider show --namespace Microsoft.CognitiveServices --expand "resourceTypes/aliases" --query "resourceTypes[?resourceType=='accounts/deployments'].aliases[].name"` and confirm 'Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/deployments/sku.name' is listed.

metadata.description: Start with Audit. Move to Deny once teams have migrated.
Deployment SKU names that are allowed, for example Standard, DataZoneStandard, ProvisionedManaged, DataZoneProvisionedManaged.
